final:
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  var n = 0
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      let s = fs.read(name) else ""
      if s.char_count() > 0
        n += 1
  n
